fusions.name: Host of Any Size
fusions.desc: Leaps onto a target up to 8 tiles away and bites, which deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Three Square Meals
fusions.desc: A hopping bite that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Table to Table
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a spot up to 8 tiles away. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.

fusions.name: Fifth Bite Feeds
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
